study: Blinded eBOSS DR16 ELG full catalog immutable byte-provenance acquisition only
purpose: Download exact public official release bytes only; SHA-pin before any table-row or mskbit interpretation
method: Only stream exact official FITS bytes to quarantine and compute SHA256; verify expected exact size, pinned first 20160 FITS header bytes SHA256, HTTP 200 Content-Length ETag Last-Modified and source URL. No FITS parser/column read, no masking/odd data inspection; SHA must be frozen independently before separate masked-catalog audit.
evidence_reassessment: Raichoor et al 2021 MNRAS 500 3254 DOI 10.1093/mnras/staa3336 table 5 states all angular vetoes except two bad eboss22 plates are bit-coded in mskbit in catalogues; full_ALLdata retention of bit8-positive targets remains UNVERIFIED. Earlier post-veto categorization was an unverified inference and is superseded, not a selection rule.
abort_on: HTTP status not 200 or final URL differs
Missing or different Content-Length, ETag, Last-Modified, or Content-Encoding not identity
Downloaded bytes or header digest differ from pinned report
Existing local file differs from expected size and header SHA
Any attempt to interpret FITS table rows before separate SHA-frozen analysis protocol
